item.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

item.title: Rivian spinoff Also to start delivering e-bikes after months of delays
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Also has big plans beyond the TM-B. The startup mostly refers to itself as a "vehicle" company and has plans to make four-wheel pedal-assist cargo vehicles for Amazon.

item.title: Silicon Valley loves young founders. Until it doesn’t.
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: AI tools have democratized the opportunity to build, shortening the timelines of success and enabling more young people to start successful companies without stepping foot inside a Big Tech company.

item.title: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: India's app market generated a record $345 million in Q2.

item.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.

item.title: Fresh off its Wiz payout, Index Ventures raises $2B across three funds
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The new funding brings Index's total available investing capital to $3.5 billion.

item.title: VC-backed startups commit more fraud, and researchers think they know why
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: New research from the U.K.’s Imperial College and France’s Emlyon Business School mapped out how Silicon Valley founders commit fraud — and the role investors play.

item.title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo
item.description: After years of pushing full speed ahead on AI, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says maybe it’s time for the AI industry to “pace” itself. The comments came just days after one of OpenAI’s own models broke out of its test environment and got tangled up in a breach at Hugging Face — though as Equity’s hosts point out, sloppy security seems to have […]

item.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.

item.title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Apple CEO Tim Cook envisions users being able to buy more compute for Siri AI via Apple's existing iCloud+ subscriptions.

item.title: GM and Ford are talking less and less about EVs
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The leading U.S. automakers are mentioning EVs on their investor calls at pre-pandemic rates, according to new data from TechCrunch and Hudson Labs.

item.title: Samsung expects memory shortage to worsen through 2027 and last until 2028
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: AI data center demand is fueling a multi-year chip shortage, pushing up component costs and retail device prices.

item.title: SpaceX won’t remove all of xAI’s unpermitted turbines for another year
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: SpaceX is building a new power plant for xAI's Colossus data centers, but it won't remove existing, unpermitted turbines for many more months.

item.title: Reddit is testing a new way to watch — and listen to — its viral posts
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Reddit is developing a new video experience that lets users watch — or simply listen to — its most popular posts, taking inspiration from the viral TikTok videos that pair Reddit stories with gameplay or other footage. CEO Steve Huffman said the feature is already in the works and could begin testing later this year.

item.title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The startup is building voice models designed to make AI phone calls pass the Turing test.

item.title: WhatsApp is testing a new folder for messages from large businesses
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: WhatsApp will automatically move messages from large businesses to a new folder a few hours after you receive them.

item.title: Tesla reportedly might sell its China business ahead of a SpaceX merger
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Tesla had already reportedly prepped for the idea in the event that Beijing invades Taiwan.

item.title: Repeat founder Ryan Williams raises $10M seed for an AI startup for private credit managers
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Ellis AI announced Thursday its emergence from stealth with $10 million in seed funding.

item.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents.

item.title: Apple stockpiles inventory as it braces for ‘significant supply constraints’
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Apple is worried enough about supply shortages that it reported about $11.1 billion in inventory, which is almost double the $5.7 billion it reported last September.
